in_hebrew.name: Stillman
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Calm and steady
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Stillman הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The name Stillman originated in the English language and is derived from the Old English words 'stille' meaning 'still' and 'mann' meaning 'man'. This name symbolizes a calm and steady individual, one who is unwavering and resolute in their actions and beliefs. In a Christian context, the name Stillman may also be seen as a reminder of God's unchanging nature and steadfast love.
